NEW CATEGORY 'process' (2 records): the corpus was FAQ-sourced and therefore complete on mid-process and edge-case questions but had zero coverage of the front-door 'how do I apply, start to finish' walkthrough. Found by comparing RAG output against a live-search baseline; 'How do I apply for e-passport?' returned only edge-case chunks at 0.68-0.73. The same gap shape is expected in ereturn (etaxnbr landing/overview) and BDRIS.

Bangla is the PRIMARY language of epassport.gov.bd. The five-step and onboarding pages expose an English toggle and BOTH versions are portal-published — the English is not Claude's translation. But the two diverge: BN step 4 says ছবি ও ফিঙ্গার প্রিন্ট (photo and fingerprint) where EN flattens it to 'biometric enrolment'; BN step 5 defines the delivery slip as the slip issued after enrolment completes, where EN only names it. Both stored verbatim; Bangla governs on conflict, per convention #1. Which version the portal authored first is NOT established and was deliberately not assumed — the corpus only needs to know which one wins. Live instance of the proposal's Section 1 claim that the Bangla and English versions of the same page sometimes disagree.

conventions_reminder: Bangla governs on conflict for every epassport.gov.bd page. Portal-published English is stored verbatim alongside it and labelled as the English version. Never store English-only for a page that has Bangla.
